title: PRE-RAID: A BUY CONTROL ON EACH PACK ROW
why: His order 2026-10-20: next to the pack items on the pre-raid page, to the right, an ability to buy those items, skipping the guns that cannot be bought. Each pack row whose item the Undercroft counter sells today gets a price button; one press takes that price from banked credits and adds one to the stash. It uses the counter own price list and stock roll, so there is one system. Guns the counter never sells have none; too few credits shows it dim with the price in red and a press does nothing. The pad runs stepper then buy.
now: On the pre-raid page each pack row now has a price button on its right. One press buys one into your stash.
